<!--
Please ensure the PR title is short and concise.
Include the Jira ticket key in the title, e.g. `[MOANK-1234]`, `[DEVOPS-4321]` or the relevant ticket, to link the PR to the corresponding issue.
-->

## Description
<!--
Brief and to the point: what has been done and why.
For small PRs, around 30 words is sufficient.
-->

## PR Type
<!-- REQUIRED: Check exactly ONE box below. -->
- [ ] 🟢 **Minor PR**
  (Small changes like minor version bumps, typos, or enhancements. Preferably linked to a Jira ticket but not required.)
- [ ] 🔴 **Major PR**
  (Significant changes that impact multiple areas. Must be linked to a Jira ticket.)
- [ ] 🔥 **Urgent PR**
  (Requires quick review. Description and Jira link can be added post-merge if super-urgent.)

## How I have tested
<!--
Brief description of what has been tested, including any ninjadeploy made to test the change.
Checkboxes are encouraged, ticked once done, e.g. "- [ ] Ninjadeploy to sandbox, verify X".
If nothing has been tested yet, write "Not tested"
-->

## Deployment
<!--
What has to happen for the change to be deployed, beyond merging: applies, syncs, releases, migrations.
Also anything deployed ahead of merge that is meant to stay, e.g. a ninjadeploy that remains in place.
Checkboxes are encouraged, ticked once done, e.g. "- [ ] terragrunt apply in staging".
If merging is all it takes, omit the section.
-->

## Expected from reviewer
<!--
Brief description on how a reviewer can validate that the PR does the correct thing.
Help the reviewer: explain what files are relevant for the PR.
For a very safe PR it could suffice with only reading through the changed files for typos.
For a very in-depth PR the reviewer should make a more extensive review.
-->

## Test protocol
<!--
A straightforward list for how to test the PR.
For very easy PRs, it may be fine to skip a test protocol.
-->

## Additional Notes
<!--
Only add things in this section if needed and helpful to actually understand this PR.
Link to chart references when configuring external charts, etc.
-->
